sections.heading: Varanasi's New Dairy: Banas Kashi Sankul at Karkhiyaon
paragraphs: Varanasi is known for silk and for the Banaras Locomotive Works, founded on 23 April 1956 as the Diesel Locomotive Works and now an electric locomotive production unit of Indian Railways. Its newest large process plant is a dairy. The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone of the Banas Dairy Sankul on 23 December 2021 at the UP State Industrial Development Authority food park at Karkhiyaon, on 30 acres and at a cost of about Rs 475 crore, with capacity to process 5 lakh litres of milk a day; on the same day he laid the stone for a biogas-based power plant at the milk producers' cooperative union plant at Ramnagar.

On 23 February 2024 he inaugurated the finished plant, known as Banas Kashi Sankul, a milk processing unit of the Banaskantha District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union, the Gujarat cooperative behind the Amul brand, which Devdiscourse described as Amul's largest plant in Varanasi. A cooperative dairy of this size in eastern Uttar Pradesh changes the local market for hygienic stainless tube, because it brings pasteurisation, cultured products, ice cream, paneer and CIP systems that are all built in sanitary stainless.

sections.heading: Which Lines in a Varanasi Dairy Need Electropolished Tube
paragraphs: A large cooperative dairy does not electropolish everything. Raw milk reception, chilled storage and plain pasteurised milk lines are cleaned every day by a validated CIP and run well on SF1 mechanically polished 304L sanitary tube. The electropolished finish pays where product sticks, burns on or carries cultures: curd, buttermilk and lassi lines, where a stray culture changes the next batch; paneer whey and cream lines; ice-cream mix and flavoured-milk lines where sugar and stabilisers cling; sweet and khoa lines where milk solids caramelise; and the CIP return leg that is sampled to prove a circuit clean.

Those lines are specified SF4 316L, mechanically polished and then electropolished to ASME BPE surface designations, because the lower Ra and chromium-rich passive surface give fat, protein and cultures less to anchor in and let the CIP cycle clear the line faster. Milk itself does not attack 304L; the reason to move to 316L on cultured, salted and hot-CIP lines is the chloride in salted products and sanitisers standing in a warm line.

sections.heading: The UPSIDA Food Park and Varanasi's Other Process Units
paragraphs: The dairy sits in a UPSIDA food park, and food parks fill. Fruit and vegetable processing, which eastern Uttar Pradesh's farms feed, uses SF4 316L on pulp, juice and concentrate lines and SF1 304L on treated water; snack, bakery and ready-to-eat units use SF4 316L on sauce, syrup and product lines and SF1 on utilities. Wikipedia's breakdown of Varanasi's manufacturing workforce still shows 51 percent in spinning and weaving and 15 percent in metal work, so the food park and the dairy are where new hygienic-piping demand in the district is concentrated.

Where a food or chemical process carries acid or chloride-bearing streams at temperature, we quote 904L, which we supply electropolished. The locomotive works and the city's metal trades are a market for ASTM A269 instrument tube and A312 pipe rather than sanitary tube, and we supply those in 304L and 316L as well.

sections.heading: Documents for a Varanasi Dairy or Food Park Audit
paragraphs: A cooperative dairy working under FSSAI and its federation's own quality system keeps material records for every product-contact line. Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report so the finish can be filed against the line list, all under a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015.

Sanitary tube to ASTM A270, seamless and welded tube to ASTM A269 and A249, and pipe to ASTM A312 are available in grades 304, 304L, 316 and 316L. If the dairy's turnkey contractor or the food park unit's auditor asks for witness points, extra tests or a defined marking format, include it in the enquiry so the quotation prices it.

sections.heading: Sending a Varanasi RFQ
paragraphs: Our quotation follows within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For dairy, food park, locomotive works or other process units in Varanasi district, include:
bullets: The plant and line: raw or pasteurised milk, cultured product, ice-cream mix, paneer or sweets, CIP, a fruit or snack product line, or instrument tube, and whether you are the plant, a turnkey contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for cultured product, sweets and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for plain milk, water and utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride service.
Sizes for each line: outside diameter, wall, length and quantity, the tube series (SMS, DIN or ASME BPE inch) and governing standard, and the fittings they must match.
Audit or inspection documentation required, and the delivery address at Karkhiyaon, Ramnagar or elsewhere in the district.

sections.heading: Supplying Varanasi and Eastern Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: Tube for Varanasi is dispatched by road from Mumbai, where we are located at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004. Lengths are capped at both ends and marked with their heat number before loading, and the dispatch date and transit to Karkhiyaon or your site are set out in writing on the quotation.
